page_title: ALA 2-0 ATM | Alaves v Atletico Madrid 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+2' 2 - 0 It's in! Carlos Vicente spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Luis Rioja (Alaves) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the top of the net. The score is now 2:0.
90+1' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
88' The game has come to an end for Andoni Gorosabel. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Luis Rioja (Alaves).
87' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.

87' The game is interrupted. Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
86' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and it's Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) prepares to take a corner kick.

82' A snap shot by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Antonio Sivera produces a good save to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
82' The attendance is 18719.
82' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle. Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
81' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Nahuel Molina and he is replaced by Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid).
81' Stefan Savic goes off the pitch and Abdellah Raihani (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
80' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
80' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Here is a change. Giuliano Simeone is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) coming on for Kike Garcia.
78' The game is interrupted now, Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Antonio Sivera gets down to his right to keep it out.
76' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
76' Kike Garcia (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Jesus Gil Manzano stops the game and makes a call. Free kick. Atl. Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
74' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

74' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul.
71' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
71' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ander Guevara (Alaves) replaces Jon Guridi.
69' Antonio Sivera leaps to intercept the corner kick from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
68' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) gets a yellow card. The referee Jesus Gil Manzano made the right call.
68' Jesus Gil Manzano rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Rafa Marin (Alaves).

68' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pablo Barrios will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
65' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
64' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
63' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Alaves will take a corner kick.
61' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
61' Jesus Gil Manzano couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) and blew his whistle.
60' The total number of attempts is 7:9.
58' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
57' Substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta walks off the pitch and Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
57' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) took the corner.

56' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.

55' Kike Garcia (Alaves) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jan Oblak has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
53' Kike Garcia (Alaves) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
51' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Alaves.
50' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
49' Koke (Atl. Madrid) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
49' Today's referee Jesus Gil Manzano rightly decides to book Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) for his harsh tackle.
47' It's a nice effort by Koke (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Antonio Sivera. Easy save.
47' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Saul Niguez comes on the pitch for Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The Alaves players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Jesus Gil Manzano. NO PENALTY!
45+3' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Alaves as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
45+2' The referee gives a penalty after pointing to the spot!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Jesus Gil Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
44' The ratio of the ball possession is 37:63.
42' Kike Garcia (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Gil Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
42' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
37' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
37' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).

36' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
33' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Gil Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
29' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
28' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Alaves.
25' Kike Garcia (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jan Oblak, who smothers the ball.
22' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
19' Javi Lopez (Alaves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
18' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

17' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
15' 1 - 0 Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
13' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
10' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) meets a cross inside the box, but Jan Oblak wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
10' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside!
9' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
7' A lofted cross from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
6' The game has begun to heat up. Javi Lopez (Alaves) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
4' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Jesus Gil Manzano shows the yellow card to Jon Guridi (Alaves) for a heavy challenge.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Alaves will kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano is the one to supervise the game today.
